answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 11156 Country: United Kingdom Title: Assalamualaikum 1-Is it permissible for a Woman who keeps her Niqab on in class to go to womens only classes where the teacher is a Male? Question: Assalamualaikum 1-Is it permissible for a Woman who keeps her Niqab on in class to go to womens only classes where the teacher is a Male? Answer ID: 11156 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 394/320=D/1430) It is allowed if needed provided she observes purdah in going to college, purdah is observed in college also without intermingling with men, she only hears the voice of teachers and there is no fear of any other similar fitnah . But, it is better to avoid in the view of present environment of colleges and evils. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
